limitations: The truth table is decoded from the pinned source and is not an independent image-quality or external golden oracle.
This is a finite Python model, not RTL equivalence, formal proof, synthesis, routed timing, resources, FPS, or hardware qualification.

No V126 candidate RTL existed in this model binding; the source and proposal are frozen V125/V124 inputs. A future candidate review must bind its exact producer source without rewriting prior results.
The model does not prove the proposed existing-edge writer schedule is naturally reached by all transactions; full controller regressions remain required.
model_kind: Python finite Boolean/transition model with exact extracted SV LUT truth tables; no RTL execution

scope.error_priority: Queue error, then child error, then foreign child owner are checked before successful dispatch consumption.
scope.full_domain: All 8192 uint13 tile values for each of four two-bit planes are decoded from the source's complete 64-bank×11-bit LUT truth table; successor/ROM/t+2 identities checked for each tuple.
scope.natural_transition_sample: Finite in-range state model covers tile skip, one-cycle MAP_REQ capture, MAP_WAIT mode2 hold, repeated DISPATCH hold, accepted nonterminal consume, terminal no-advance, empty-plane hold, NEXT_PLANE current-cell recompute, reset/abort/retry and blocked-start preservation.
scope.ownership: Full 32-bit frame epoch, two-bit plane and full 13-bit current tile witness; stale or mismatched address/cell owners are rejected. Payload may remain stale after invalidation but cannot authorize consume.
scope.wrap: 13-bit t+1/t+2 arithmetic includes 8191 wrap. Those full-domain wrap contexts are algebraic only; actual MAP_REQ rejects current tiles at or beyond tile_count.
